about: Staging JS for tools/uishots.ps1, one entry per screen of ui-screens.json. Each js is the body of an async function run on a FRESH page of the fixture (storage wiped, booted), with U = window.__uis (the prelude: wait, key, down, up, hold, click, on, el, closeModals, untitle, until, floor = title to welcome pack to the Undercroft floor, dep = deploy a kit, raid, near, modal). It returns nothing, or SKIP: why. expect is a JS predicate that must hold after staging or the screen is reported NOT STAGED. query is appended to the fixture URL. before is the prose recipe the before shots used. ART SURVEY (2026-10-18): the prelude ends with scene-lib.js (window.__art), so a screen is one line, return await window.__art.scene('duo',{}) or ...scene('duo',{plate:true}); the returned note is a JSON line with the screen position of every character. (a11-a17 picture job)
